shared_elements: horizontal band or register dividing the field
repeated row of small similar motifs along a band
justification: Both are rectangular stone surfaces worked in low relief with profile animal figures and at least one horizontal band of repeated small elements running across the field, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A stacks isolated, boldly rounded, sparsely detailed creatures in loose vertical registers, while B is a densely incised, strictly bilateral composition of large winged figures flanking a central motif above a continuous text-like band.
